argv: A hop's dots are hard to see where they lie over the walked-street line
replay-ceremony ui 6: a hop's dots stand on white discs while the replay tells, so the first clause is settled; the rest stands
ops.body: - In landscape there is no room under a card, so its pin sits partly under it (RC14); a change of the screen's size mid-replay (rotation, Safari's bar) rebuilds the telling, untested; the camera's arithmetic does not wrap at the antimeridian; `ceremony/room.ts` assumes a 34 px caption strip where the web's is about 32

argv: A walk shorter than what zoom 15 shows opens closer
replay-ceremony ui 7 and ui 8: the trace fades out and the walker in through the dive, and the first beat's fit is north-up; the short walk's dive stays the owner's
ops.body: - [owner] A walk shorter than what zoom 15 shows opens closer than the walking zoom (the whole is capped at 17), so its "dive" pulls back; capping the whole at 15 would change the card's map too
